title: On weighted forms in many variables
summary: In this paper, we introduce several novel approaches utilizing the circle method to obtain the asymptotic formula for the number of integral points of bounded height lying on a hypersurface in a weighted projective space. Let $F(\mathbf{x} ; \mathbf{y})$ be a given weighted form of degree $d$ in variables $\mathbf{x} \in \mathbb{R}^{s_1}$ and $\mathbf{y} \in \mathbb{R}^{s_2}$, where variables $\mathbf{x}$ and $\mathbf{y}$ have weights $w_1$ and $w_2$ with $w_1 w_1 w_2$.
